notes: MACULA distributes the gloss of `בְּעֵינָיו` across its segments in reverse (s006 glossed *his.own*, s007 glossed *eyes*); the surface and lemma pairing is what the units follow, per rule 39, so s006 takes *eyes* and s007 the possessive.
*his own* is rule 18's emphatic possessive on the suffix rather than *own* attaching to the host noun.
